title: Qwen3.6-27B private-c1 decode-scratch single-owner arena

hardware.primary: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX / gfx1100 / HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 / PCI 0000:10:00.0 / sysfs card0 / 23.984375 GiB VRAM
hardware.safeguard: AMD Radeon Pro W7900 / gfx1100 / HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 / PCI 0000:0d:00.0 / sysfs card1 / 44.984375 GiB VRAM

implementation.problem: The persistent private-c1 decode workspace requested the correct bytes but spread 188 state, BF16-KV, metadata, and operation-workspace ranges across 188 HIP owners, adding material allocator/mapping overhead.
implementation.change: Allocate one 256-byte-aligned physical owner and expose the unchanged 188 logical DeviceBuffer views at their planned offsets.
implementation.scope: gfx1100 capability keyed to Qwen3.6-27B MOSTLY_Q4_K_M private c1 only; shared runners, c>N, peer models/backends, explicit opt-out, and owner-allocation denial retain dedicated owners.

red_green.red: The dense Qwen3.6 fixture allocated 188 independent physical owners and had no policy resolver or owner-count telemetry.
red_green.green: The same 188 non-overlapping logical ranges lie within one aligned owner; dedicated, allocation-denial, c>N, shared-runner, peer-model/backend, and disable fallbacks remain covered.
red_green.tests: uv run pytest -q tests/test_qwen35_gguf_decode_scratch_arena.py tests/test_qwen35_resident_batch_layout.py && uv run pytest -q tests/test_qwen35_gguf_int8_kv_policy.py

protocol.hipengine: Selector-unset package-default sole-T16 session, repeated token 9707, one discarded warmup plus three measured persistent reset/replays, bulk prefill, BF16 KV, HIP graph decode, 128 timed transitions, cached compiler artifacts.
protocol.whole_device_memory: 5 ms sysfs VRAM samples around the complete child process. Peak delta is peak minus pre-process baseline.
protocol.command_template: env -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_GDN_PREFILL_MODE -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SELECTED_PREFILL_MODE -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_LINEAR_ATTN_CONV_PREFILL_MODE -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_PREFILL_ROUTER_SELECT_THREADS -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_PREFILL_DEVICE_METADATA -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_PRIVATE_C1_DECODE_SCRATCH_ARENA HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<1 XTX|0 W7900> HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python scripts/qwen35_gguf_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --token-id 9707 --prompt-length <512|1024|4096|8192> --decode-tokens 128 --warmup-decode-tokens 1 --warmup-runs 1 --measured-runs 3 --persistent-session --force-bulk-prefill --bulk-prefill-attention-mode bulk --use-wmma-prefill --use-gemv-decode --graph-replay-decode --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build --json <output>

safeguards.dense_nextn_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 uv run pytest -q tests/test_qwen35_gguf_mtp_e2e.py::test_dense_q4_k_m_nextn_transaction_and_provider_match_scalar_ar

decision: Retain as the model-scoped default because it is exact, saves whole-device memory at all four shapes, and has no material XTX/W7900 prefill or decode regression. Keep the memory objective open: Vulkan still leads by 0.339/0.495/0.993/0.994 GiB at 512/1K/4K/8K; 4K decode and Vulkan MTP also remain blocked.
